messages:
anya: FYI onboarding kick-off with Meridian Health — they sent a combined DPA + vendor security form. Key asks: KMS ownership, key rotation schedule, embeddings retention policy, and data export boundaries. Can we get answers by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin_eng: I can take KMS + rotation. We use customer-managed keys via KMS integration; rotation every 90 days for host keys, ledger keys rotated 180 days. KMS alias: `alias/redwood-<customer>` — will paste exact policy.
sarah_privacy: I’ll handle retention wording for embeddings. Meridian requires a 30-day deletion window for user-identified vectors — is that feasible? Also need subprocessors list + data flow diagram.
kevin_eng: Embeddings retention is configurable per-tenant; default is 365 days. We can set to 30d but need to confirm cost/perf implications. Quick config example: `POST /v1/tenants/<id>/settings { "embeddings_retention_days": 30 }`
anya: Great. @kevin_eng can you paste the KMS policy snippet and a link to infra-runbook? legal needs exact text to drop into the DPA.
kevin_eng: Pasting minimal snippet:
```
{ "Principal": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-svc", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345" }
```
Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kms-keys
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded for `private-deploy/meridian` — build #4521 :rocket:
jake_cs: Meridian asked for a copy of the SOC2 scope (in-scope services). We can attach the SOC2 scoping doc, but need approval from security to confirm nothing changed since last audit.
sarah_privacy: I’ll pull scoping snapshot and confirm. Also flag: they asked whether embeddings are pseudonymized before storage — we should avoid "pseudonymized" unless we have documented transform.
kevin_eng: We currently store raw embeddings (float vectors) alongside hashed IDs. We can provide statement: "embeddings stored as float vectors tied to anonymized internal IDs; raw PII is not stored with embeddings." Want a short sentence for the form?
anya: Yes — short, legal-friendly sentence. Also we need contact for KMS audits — who owns KMS rotation on-call?
kevin_eng: @oliver_sre owns rotation on-call. Oliver, can you confirm rotation runbook and SOC2 evidence path? :wave:
oliver_sre: Confirmed — rotation is automated via our key-lifecycle job, evidence available in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/link-to-kms-evidence. I can export key rotation logs if needed.
sarah_privacy: Perfect. I'll assemble answers into a single doc and drop into the vendor form. Plan: draft by today EOD, review with @legal_team, then send to Meridian tomorrow.
anya: Thanks all. If anyone sees tradeoffs for setting retention to 30d, ping me ASAP. :thumbsup:
